__doc: Fees collected and reward tokens distributed, for the dashboard's first two
cards. No explorer knows these — they are protocol figures — so this file is
the simplest way to feed them: same-origin, no CORS, no infrastructure.
EMPTY ON PURPOSE. Nulls render as em dashes on the page. Either fill them in
by hand, or point scripts/index-rewards.mjs at your contracts and let the
'Index rewards' workflow rewrite this file on a schedule.
Keys are plain numbers, not strings, and not pre-formatted.
